pages.text: A Mountaintear is an Arcane Gem formed from an orange-spectrum piece of $(l:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in a pendeloque cut.$(br2)When activated, a Mountaintear will conjure a block of lava at a distance of up to 40 blocks at the cost of one point of charge.
To recharge a dun Mountaintear, toss it in a block of lava.

When placed in a Lightwell with access to the sky, a Mountaintear generates lava at a slow rate. While it's possible for a Mountaintear to shatter, the chances of shattering are astronomically unlikely. For all intents and purposes, a Mountaintear lasts indefinitely unless its Lightwell is broken. Once placed in a Lightwell, a Mountaintear cannot be retrieved.
pages.title: Astral Sorcery Lightwell
